negative_reviews.author: B Liaw
negative_reviews.text: Very unorganised n service was bad.

negative_reviews.author: David Cooper
negative_reviews.text: Unfortunately we had a very bad experience. We ordered 2 meals, one arrived in 5 minutes and we waited for the other to arrive.  My partner wanted us to eat together and waited for my food to arrive. 5 minutes later we reminded the waitress who said it would be another 3 minutes. By this time my partners food was cold.  We waited another 5 minutes and nothing happened. We again complained to the waiter who said some went wrong in the kitchen. We then talked to the manager and told him what had happened. With his agreement we then left without paying.

negative_reviews.author: Lee’s Travels
negative_reviews.text: Service was slow although the servers were welcoming and apologetic. Aware the food is served at different times but the two main courses came 20 minutes apart and then a hair was found in my dish. The server removed this from the bill along with the service charge.
